useCase: stylized-concept, followed by precise-object-edit where noted

god_crystal_guard.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent attack VFX master for a mobile HD-2D pixel-art strategy battle, god_crystal_guard (守卫机兵), rank 4. Input image 1 is the project's own unit portrait, a STYLE, EQUIPMENT and PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY; do not include the robot or its body in the output. Create one isolated left-to-right crystal barrier counterpulse: a broad faceted turquoise diamond at the center of a stout octagonal gold-and-ivory shield shockwave, with two offset cyan crystal shards and a short squared turquoise energy trail. Echo the portrait's cyan core, navy insets and warm gold trim. Shield silhouette must dominate, distinct from a spell orb or sword slash. High-rank luminous but controlled, hard clustered pixel-art edges, thick enough to read at 64px on light and dark battle backgrounds. Place the entire effect in the central 70% of a square canvas with genuinely fully transparent RGBA margins. No character, face, scenery, floor, background color, checkerboard, text, UI, frame, bloom haze, blur, gradient cloud or watermark.

phantom_god.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent attack VFX master for mobile HD-2D pixel-art battle, phantom_god (光学拟态机), rank 5. Input image 1 is this project's own portrait; use its angular cyan-violet wing crystals, silver-blue alloy and gold joints only as visual reference. EXCLUDE the robot, limbs, head, eyes and body. A left-to-right optical mirage strike: one sharp cyan prism-lance pierces rightward through three staggered translucent violet-blue triangular afterimages, with a small broken geometric interference rune behind it and a few stepped pixel diffraction shards. Distinct from a shield pulse, physical sword slash, or round spell orb. Most parts connected into ONE clear diagonal silhouette; high-rank spectacle yet readable at 64px on light and dark backgrounds. Hard clustered hand-painted pixel-art edges, controlled brightness and dark blue contour. Fully transparent RGBA square canvas with generous blank border on every side; effect entirely within central 70% and no cropping. No character, scenery, floor, background color, checkerboard, frame, UI, text, blur, soft haze or watermark.
phantom_god.framingEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an original transparent pixel-art prism-lance attack VFX. Change only the framing: keep the entire prism-lance, crystals, rune, colors, shape, crisp pixel edges, and alpha exactly as they look, but scale the complete VFX uniformly smaller and center it so the visible alpha occupies no more than the central 75% width and 65% height of the same square canvas. There must be at least 12% completely transparent padding on LEFT and RIGHT and at least 17% on TOP and BOTTOM. Do not crop anything, add anything, replace the lance, add background or change its direction. Output genuinely transparent RGBA, not black or checkerboard.
phantom_god.finalFramingEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the original blue-violet prism-lance VFX. Adjust FRAMING ONLY: scale its complete visible effect uniformly to about 88% of its original size, keeping the same center. Leave approximately 6–8% genuine transparent padding on left and right and plenty of clear margin above and below. This rank-5 effect must remain large enough to be legible at 64px, so do not shrink it to 75% width. Preserve every crystal, the rune, their colors and pixel-art silhouette; no redesign, added objects, crop, blur or background. RGBA alpha-zero margins.
